evidence.quote: Rotary heat exchanger is regenerative type of air to air heat exchanger with diameter from 250 mm up to 5000 mm. Made with aluminum to reach above 85% efficiency. || Counter-flow plate heat exchangers with high temperature efficiency up to 93% – a perfect solution for small and medium air volumes for residential or commercial applications to provide air to air heat recovery at the highest level.
